system.description: Craft illusions affecting all senses desired, though still insubstantial (e.g. an illusory dagger looks and feels sharp but its slash won't crease flesh). Unlike Ignis Fatuus, others can handle the illusion (e.g. toss the dagger to a friend) and it will move like the real object. Expend a Willpower Trait and a Blood Trait, and win a Social Challenge; conditions for persistence match Ignis Fatuus.
system.duration: Until dismissed, disproved, or you leave
